propositions: S3 ticket-store backend requires git-remote-s3>=0.3.2 as an optional dependency that is never required by core rebar
A runtime guard must verify both that the git-remote-s3 console script exists on PATH and that the installed distribution meets the >=0.3.2 version minimum
require_s3_helper() must raise OptionalDependencyError with an actionable install hint when the script is missing, dist metadata is absent, version is too old, or version is unparseable
Version comparison must be stdlib-only using tuple comparison of parsed numeric components, treating non-numeric leading components as failing the minimum check
New pyproject.toml [project.optional-dependencies] entry s3 = ["git-remote-s3>=0.3.2"] and _optional.py EXTRAS entry enable consistent missing-extra messaging across all rebar optional features
